response.sql: WITH rc AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), sh AS (SELECT rating, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM rc), kept AS (SELECT rating, cnt, share FROM sh WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM sh)) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM sh)) AS avg_excess FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: 'Total count of those ratings' is read as the sum of the distinct-film counts across the kept ratings, not the number of kept ratings.
Ratings with NULL rating are treated as their own group; the verified data shows 5 non-null ratings, so this has no effect.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Total count of those ratings' means the number of ratings kept (count of rows), not the sum of their film counts.
